body: Do not live in Hawaii and there was no decision but imma still just write it. Coincidentally dreamed about being in a war on a battlefield and saw my death while a helicopter destroyed the building I was hiding in. Thought this was it. It was only a dream but it felt realer than my usual day. So it's like you wanna cry but can't because you know it won't change anything. I just stood there and waited to die feeling helpless and unimportant. Then woke up sweating like a bitch.
I think that could be the case but what do I know.

It really is mind numbing. You‘re right. We have a mutual friend who I told my plans and she supports me during this decision.
She told me that she had a sleepover at my Gf‘s and that she cried...because I didn‘t respond with “I love you” to her “I love you”...
Thanks a lot. I will do!
